meta.dataset: LRO Diviner Global Cumulative Products (GCP), DATA_SET_ID LRO-L-DLRE-5-GCP-V1.0, PRODUCT_VERSION_ID 1 (_002 files); Williams et al. (2017) Icarus 283, 300-325
meta.provider: NASA PDS Geosciences Node (Washington University in St. Louis)
meta.resolution: 0.5 deg x 0.5 deg x 0.25 h local time
meta.processing: per 0.5-deg bin: mean of valid 0.25-h tbol records with 13<LT<14 minus 1<LT<2 (>=2 of 4 valid each); window value = mean over bins whose centres fall inside the 55.6 km AE square
meta.licence: NASA PDS archive product; licence not restated; cite Williams et al. (2017)
meta.limitations: 0.5-deg bins are coarse relative to the 55.6 km window (few bins); cumulative average over all seasons; bolometric brightness temperature, not MODIS split-window LST.
